topic: Does gender role play affect the accuracy of language models on answering math questions?

review.Summary: The paper investigates whether gender role play affects the accuracy of language models in solving math problems. However, the experimental setup is flawed due to dataset structure issues, which prevent the execution of the experiments and the collection of any valid results. The paper lacks sufficient detail on how accuracy is measured and how the role-play prompts are justified.
Strengths: Relevant to discussions on gender bias in AI
Use of a real-world dataset from HuggingFace
Weaknesses: Dataset structure issues prevent any valid experimental results
Lack of detail on how accuracy is measured
Prompt formulations are not sufficiently justified
Limited discussion on how to resolve dataset inconsistencies
Questions: How was the correct answer determined for the math problems?
What steps were taken to resolve the dataset structure issue?
How were the role-play prompts validated for their impact on model performance?
What is the methodology for evaluating confidence levels?
Limitations: Dataset structure issues prevent experimental execution
Lack of detail on evaluation methodology
